rules.heading: THE SAMSKARAS (ANNA PRASHANA)

planetary.freeform: Forenoon is recommended; birth nakshatra is also good.

rules.notes: Anna Prashana should be done in the Shukla Paksha during the forenoon, and birth nakshatra is favorable.

rules.heading: LAGNA SHUDDHI OR FAVOURABLE ASCENDANT IN ANNA PRASHANA

planetary.freeform: Benefics in 1, 4, 7, 5, 9, 3 houses; no planet in the 10th house; malefic planets in 3, 6, 11 houses; Ascendant, 8th, and 6th houses without the Moon.

rules.notes: Specifies favorable house placements for benefics and malefics, and lists certain nakshatras as inauspicious according to some teachers.

rules.heading: THE EFFECTS OF THE PLACES OF THE PLANETS IN ANNA PRASHANA

planetary.freeform: Emaciated Moon or Full Moon or Jupiter or Mercury or Mars or Sun or Saturn in houses 9, 5, 12, 1, 4, 7 from natal ascendant.

rules.notes: Details the specific life or health results of having various planets placed in the 9th, 5th, 12th, 1st, 4th, or 7th houses during Anna Prashana.
